title: Track Cardano Asset Stats, Price Movements, Wallet Alerts, and More via Telegram

ms.promise:
・A detailed specification document outlining all planned functionalities for the Telegram bot, including tracked stats like token prices, wallet transactions, token supply changes, and alert structures.
・Research and identify all necessary data sources and technical requirements for the bot’s development.
ms.criteria:
・The specification document includes a comprehensive list of features, data points, a basic application architecture showing how indexer, backend API, and Telegram bot components interact.
・Technical feasibility for each proposed feature is addressed in the document.
・Final specifications are reviewed and approved by the project team.
ms.report:
We are pleased to submit the final specification document for Milestone 1 of the Cardano Sentinel project: “Finalizing Research and Specifications for the Telegram Bot.”
This milestone was focused on research, planning, and confirming the technical feasibility of delivering a real-time blockchain monitoring bot for Telegram, aligned with the use cases and data requirements defined in our original Catalyst proposal.
What This Submission Includes:
・A complete breakdown of the three Telegram bot types (Personal, Public, and Group), including their features, commands, and alert behaviour
・A summary of functional objectives such as real-time alerts, scalability, and token tracking capacity
・A system architecture overview and list of all supporting components (indexer, sync engine, alert processor, data sources)
・A detailed feature list, tracked data points, and technical feasibility confirmation
・Internal sign-off and readiness to advance to Milestone 2

Progress Update:
Although this milestone only required planning and specification, we’re already ahead of schedule. All major backend components have been implemented, and the Telegram bot is fully functional and live in testing. A Discord bot version has also been developed (outside the scope of Catalyst funding) to further extend functionality.
📘 Final Specification Document (PDF): https://github.com/ADA-Markets/Docs/blob/main/telegram-bot/Telegram%20Bot%20Milestone%201.pdf
This milestone should meet the deliverables outlined in the milestone 1, and we look forward to submitting Milestone 2, where we will validate the live indexing system and demonstrate token and wallet data tracking with test documentation. 
If you require anything else for this milestone we are happy to provide it. Thanks for your time

ms.promise:
・An operational indexer capable of tracking stats and data listed in the initial spec doc from milestone 1
・Documentation of indexer processes and data workflows.
ms.criteria:
The indexer tracks:
・Token price for at least 20 Cardano native tokens by market cap.
・Wallet transactions (incoming and outgoing) for at least 2 monitored wallets.

Test cases are designed for each tracked stat (price, wallet TX, supply).
Test cases are documented (inputs, expected outputs, pass/fail results).
ms.report:
We are pleased to submit the second milestone for the Cardano Sentinel project, confirming the successful implementation and operational deployment of our blockchain indexer. This indexer powers all token tracking and wallet monitoring features across the Telegram bot system outlined in Milestone 1.
What This Submission Demonstrates:
・Real-time tracking of token prices for 20+ Cardano native assets
・Live monitoring of wallet transactions (inbound, outbound)
・Indexed price and transaction data stored via a PostgreSQL + Ogmios + Redis stack
・Full support for Telegram user queries (e.g. /price, wallet activity)
・Test cases validating data retrieval, swap recognition, and alert functionality
・Screenshots and a recorded walkthrough demonstrating the system in action

Validation:
All test cases were executed using the live Telegram bot connected to the Cardano mainnet. Results were verified via internal logs and PostgreSQL data records. Screenshots and a video walkthrough are included as evidence of milestone completion.
Included Materials:
・📘 Specification Document: https://github.com/ADA-Markets/Docs/blob/main/telegram-bot/Telegram%20Bot%20Milestone%202.pdf
・🎥 Demonstration Video: https://youtu.be/7LePgTQ9NEQ

Video Timestamps: 
・1:12 Telegram bot intro
・2:20 Wallet tracking
・4:15 Price alerts

The document and video above should demonstrate that the Cardano Sentinel indexing system is fully implemented, functional, and meets all specified deliverables. The system is live and operational in development, and all technical goals outlined for this phase have been achieved in full. In Milestone 3, we will provide direct access to the bot for reviewers to test first-hand.
If there’s anything else required to complete this milestone, we’re happy to provide it. Thanks again for your support.
